note: Example data: an invented online store selling home coffee brewing gear, with invented outlets, writers, channels and orders, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.

Here is our product list with prices, unit costs, stock and last season's peak units, and a Shopify orders export for last season's placement windows. Lead times I use: print 16 weeks before on-sale, online guides 8 weeks, newsletters and blogs 4 weeks, YouTube 5 weeks. GA4 and our seeding log sheet are connected too. Here are last season's guides and the YouTube channels I follow.
